subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Data handling: Collect, sort and represent objects
source.subtopic: Collect and sort objects, discuss sorted collections and represent sorted objects

show.line: We collected leaves! Sort them by colour, then draw a row for each colour. Which row is longest?

rounds.prompt: Look at the rows. How many green leaves?
Which colour has the fewest leaves?
Sort the toys. Has wheels, or no wheels?
Three toys have wheels, two do not. Which group is bigger? Say it.
Which picture shows the sorted toys as rows?
rounds.praise: Rows make it easy to count!

hints: Decide the rule first. Colour, size or shape.
Put each group in a row. Then count the rows.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will sort by colour.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Green, green, brown. All in the green row!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The brown leaf goes in the brown row.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look at the colour. Brown goes with brown!

parent_line: Can sort objects, show the groups in rows and talk about them.
